projects.title: Sheetr – A Spritesheet Packer
projects.desc: Sheetr is a small web app designed to create sprite sheets from individual images. Simply drag and drop your images into Sheetr, and it will automatically generate a sprite sheet along with a .json file containing information about each group of frames. For example, if you have two folders with frames for two separate animations, Sheetr will combine them into one sheet and generate the necessary data to locate the frames for each animation.

projects.title: Tumble
projects.desc: Tumble is a 3D platforming game where you play as a jiggly cube, tumbling through abstract worlds. You can cling to sticky walls and slide across icy surfaces. Made with the Unity Engine.

projects.title: WL-Transit
projects.desc: WL-Transit is a web app designed primarily for mobile devices, displaying real-time departure times near your location in Vienna. It uses open-government data from the City of Vienna.

projects.title: 3D Mandelbulb Explorer
projects.desc: The 3D Mandelbulb Explorer is a small web app written with WebGPU, visualizing a Mandelbulb—the 3D version of the famous Mandelbrot set. Several visual tweaks have been applied, and a small UI allows you to adjust various effects.
